effects.effect: While you are in your hybrid form, your size is 1L, you have a +2 bonus to speed, and you ignore [difficult terrain](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/difficult-terrain). At 4th level, the first time you take hybrid form in an encounter, you gain 10 [temporary Stamina](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/temporary-stamina).
